item.title: A fast and secure tar parser for the Rust ecosystem
item.description: We're releasing tar-codec, a new tar encoding/decoding library for Rust. tar-codec is already the default in uv, and improves uv's tar handling performance by over 2x while also improving our posture against archive differentials. (1 source: lobsters)
